limitations: Representative controlled workload only; not the historical session-throughput/three-browser performance matrix.
OS scheduling affects observed deadline/queue intervals. Snapshot lock completion is an upper bound after the observed waiter is released.

The native interactive harness constructs its default configuration and did not apply the requested change-stream environment overrides. Actual snapshot/resume lifetimes were 300/82800 seconds, as recorded. The isolated SQL fixture forced snapshot-session expiry before an ordinary worker cleanup turn; this run did not wait 300 wall-clock seconds. Harness environment override behavior is not qualified.

measurementBoundaries.pool: Before withConn to callback is checkout/admission latency, including any connection setup/bookkeeping; controlled held single lease, not a production wait histogram.

measurementBoundaries.sql: Logical SQL calls; statement-log fallback counts only observed complete log lines and has logger-resolution limits, not RTTs.
